scope: Metadata-only first-pass reproducible 437 published Movebank Datapackages. Not GPS track eligibility, not per-animal data analysis, not taxonomically verified species richness.

rules.source_position_flag: Any dc.subject has case-insensitive GPS word, Argos word, satellite telemetry, GSM telemetry, radio telemetry, VHF word or FastLoc. Absence is unknown, not a factual absence of GPS files.
rules.source_species_label_regex: ^[A-Z][a-z]{2,} [a-z]{2,}(?:-[a-z]+)?$ on dc.subject only; NOT external taxonomy resolved.
rules.license_handling: CC0/CC-BY prioritized for raw data feasibility; CC-BY-NC held for separate noncommercial-permission review; missing rights held.
rules.caution: Never treat metadata priority as fully eligible. Must read original data files/reference data, species identity, location sensor, tracking blocks and shared environment.
